To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
G-REMiTi algorithm can achieve better energy efficiency than other existing protocols in wireless ad hoc multicast communications.
G-REMiTs performance can be improved if the energy consumption of the transceiver electronics is included in the energy consumption model.
G-REMiTs algorithm is more suitable than other existing algorithms for building energy efficient multicasts in WANETs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and analysis of an energy efficient multicast algorithm for wireless ad hoc network.
the design of a distributed algorithm that builds an energy efficient multicast routing tree in a WANET.
building a multicast tree in WANETs which can save the energy consumption of the nodes and the total energy of the network.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed G-REMiTs algorithm is an efficient and effective solution to build an energy efficient multicast routing tree in a WANET.
the proposed algorithm is a good choice for energy saving in wireless ad hoc network.
the proposed algorithm can achieve better energy efficiency in WANET.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the G-REMiTs algorithm is a good solution to build energy efficient multicast tree for WANET.
the G-REMiTs is a promising energy saving multicast routing algorithm for WANET.

G-REMiTs performance is very promising for WANETs with long range radio and it is also suitable for WANETs equipped with short range radio if we can find an energy efficient transmission power adjustment scheme for such a network.
The main takeaway from our work is that
G-REMiTs energy saving scheme is not only suitable for short range radio, but also for long range radio.
the energy consumption model for a wireless network is important and should not be ignored in the design of energy saving algorithms for WANET.
G-REMiTs energy efficient multicast tree is more suitable for long range radio than short range radio.
